data.body: Landed as 90a6a07e522dcb0c22d2d427df4deefba5fbc353 via Gerrit change 1444 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved; CI run 31046762960 success on ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13). Decision executed per operator: CodeQL moved from weekly '23 4 * * 1' to '35 */6 * * *', staggered against test.yml :41 / optionality.yml :47 / verify-identity.yml :53. The stale '28x cost increase' header rationale was removed — navapbc/rebar is public, so CodeQL and Actions minutes are free. Test coverage retargeted, not deleted: codeql moved out of _OWN_CADENCE into a new schedule-only 6-hourly cohort (it has no push trigger, so it cannot join _SIX_HOURLY, which also drives the push-preservation case); its no-push and workflow_dispatch cover retained via _NO_MAIN_PUSH; new cases pin the exact cron and the distinct-minute staggering invariant.
